Five things to do before it hits 32°. 🥶

Fairfield County homeowners: the first hard freeze usually lands in November. Shut off and drain the outside spigots, bring the hoses in, get the sprinklers blown out, find your main water shutoff, and wrap the pipes in the cold spots. Swipe for the how.

Send this to someone who still has a hose on the spigot.
